home.aboutP1: Akansho is a home services platform where you can find local professionals for work at home — such as plumbers, electricians, carpenters, painters, drivers, and more.
home.aboutP2: Choose a service, share your location, browse available professionals, and request service when you are ready. You only need an account when an action such as sending a request requires it.
home.faq1Q: What services are available on Akansho?
home.faq1A: Akansho offers home service categories such as plumber, electrician, carpenter, and more. See the full list on Home or in service search.
home.faq2Q: How do I find a plumber in my area?
home.faq2A: Choose plumber, pick your city or area, then search. Available professionals will appear in the list.
home.faq3A: Yes. Choose electrician, browse professionals, then send a request. You may need to sign in to send the request.
home.faq4Q: How do I make a service request on Akansho?
home.faq4A: Choose a service and location, browse professionals, and tap request. Sign-in is asked only when needed.
home.faq5Q: Can I see professionals near me?
home.faq5A: Yes. After you choose a location or use GPS, professionals linked to your area can appear.
